messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are delighted to assist Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and remain eager to serve all your requirements from our extensive product range.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To give you complete visibility into our underlying costs, please note that LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost. 

As your trusted partner, we pride ourselves on exceptional distributor service and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the underlying cost movements. We recognise the input-cost increases you describe; our analysis supports a lower price within a longer agreement rather than a standalone discount.

Our demand forecast for this part has changed +4.2% (fc:360020@2026-09).

The longer agreement offers a practical basis for standardised supply with low administrative effort. We are flexible on payment terms; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 4.43 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 4.45 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement.

Which volume or contract length would let you improve the price further?

We appreciate your straightforward approach and look forward to agreeing a practical renewal package.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. However, we appreciate your proposal for a 24-month agreement, which provides a basis for a slight price adjustment. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Based on the 24-month term and 30 days net payment, we can offer a revised price of €4.88 per unit. As an alternative, we offer a price of €4.88 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear Florian Gruber,

Thank you for improving your price in exchange for faster payment. We recognise that you need binding volume rather than forecast growth; the commitment sentence below answers your volume question.

We are making a modest move on payment in exchange for a further price reduction, within a simple volume arrangement that limits administration. We are flexible on contract length: Option A retains the term you proposed, while Option B offers a longer agreement; which works best for you? We can commit to 20,000 units per year over 24 months, as set out in the term sheets.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 4.47 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net.
Option B: EUR 4.47 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net.

We look forward to your response on this straightforward supply arrangement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us. We appreciate your revised offer and the volume commitment, and we have already taken that volume change data into account. Regarding your question, we do not share detailed cost breakdowns as a matter of company policy. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Based on the 24-month agreement and 45 days net payment, we can offer a revised price of €4.89 per unit. To summarize, our current Angebot is a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that our Angebot stays valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
